mods.name: Xaero Custom Waypoint Colors
mods.description: Adds a color picker option to Xaero's Minimap waypoints, letting them go beyond the 16 preset colors.

releases.notes:
- Fixed the scaling of the color picker at higher gui scales and resolutions. It should now always fit on the screen and should try and keep the same size depending on the scale [(#3)](https://github.com/loooosh98/xaero-custom-waypoint-colors/issues/3)
- Added a manual scaling option in case the auto scaling is too big / small (Mod Menu is needed to access the mod's settings) [(#3)](https://github.com/loooosh98/xaero-custom-waypoint-colors/issues/3)
- World folders for the custom waypoints now get deleted with the world
- Fixed custom waypoints not keeping their color on world transfer
- Fixed the dropdown menu defaulting to the custom option when editing a custom waypoint with a preset color selected on window resizes
- Fixed the color picker accepting non-hex values when manually entering a hex code

mods.name: Xaero Custom Waypoint Colors
mods.description: Adds a color picker option to Xaero's Minimap waypoints, letting them go beyond the 16 preset colors.

releases.notes:
- Color gradients are much smoother 
- The custom color preview now matches the blur of the GUI when no color is selected
- White is no longer the default selected color
- Resizing the window in the waypoint creation menu no longer resets the selected custom color
- Mass editing waypoints at the same time no longer defaults their color
- Color picker dot is no longer fully white. It now shows your selected color in the middle.
- Implemented atomic saving system
- New icon
- Updated for Xaero's Minimap version '26.2.0'

**You must use Xaero's Minimap version 26.2.0 or higher**
